steps.en: OCMS receives the furnish or redirect request from PLUS with the details
steps.id: OCMS menerima permintaan furnish atau redirect dari PLUS beserta datanya

steps.en: OCMS continues only after PLUS confirmed that the old details may be overwritten
steps.id: OCMS baru lanjut setelah PLUS mengonfirmasi data lama boleh ditimpa
steps.why_en: OCMS has no way to know whether the PLUS user confirmed; it overwrites on every request.
steps.why_id: OCMS tidak bisa tahu apakah user PLUS sudah konfirmasi; setiap permintaan langsung menimpa.

steps.en: OCMS updates the hirer or driver details for the notice
steps.id: OCMS memperbarui data hirer atau driver untuk notice itu

steps.en: OCMS records the username of the PLUS user who made the request
steps.id: OCMS mencatat username user PLUS yang membuat permintaan
steps.why_en: Only one of the two PLUS update routes stores the username, and sending it is optional.
steps.why_id: Hanya satu dari dua jalur update PLUS yang menyimpan username, dan pengirimannya opsional.

steps.en: OCMS follows up the latest hirer or driver in the automated workflow
steps.id: OCMS menindaklanjuti hirer atau driver terbaru lewat alur otomatis
